sai abhyankkar.name: Sai Abhyankkar
sai abhyankkar.bio: Sai Abhyankkar is an Indian music composer, playback singer, and producer working primarily in Tamil cinema and the independent music scene. Born into a musical family as the son of celebrated playback singers Tippu and Harini, he trained in both vocals and multiple instruments from an early age. He broke out into massive global stardom with his viral independent debut singles "Katchi Sera" and "Aasa Kooda," before successfully transitioning into a highly sought-after cinematic film composer.

anirudh ravichander.name: Anirudh Ravichander
anirudh ravichander.bio: Anirudh Ravichander, mononymously known as Anirudh, is an Indian music composer, playback singer, and producer working predominantly in Tamil cinema, alongside Telugu and Hindi films. Born into an artistic family in Chennai—as the son of actor Ravi Raghavendra and nephew of superstar Rajinikanth—he achieved overnight global stardom at age 21 with his viral debut track "Why This Kolaveri Di" from the 2012 film 3. a. r. rahman.name: A. R. Rahman
a. r. rahman.bio: A.R. Rahman is an acclaimed Indian composer, singer-songwriter, and music producer famously nicknamed the "Mozart of Madras." He revolutionized the Indian music industry by seamlessly blending traditional Indian classical music with electronic sounds and global orchestration. He has won two Academy Awards, two Grammy Awards, a BAFTA, a Golden Globe, and has been honored with the Padma Bhushan.
